## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `CreatingAnAgent`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `creating-an-agent`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **CreatingAnAgent**.

## Step 2: Launching the wizard

1. <!-- manual: Open your integration project in WSO2 Integrator. -->
2. Select **+ Add Artifact** from the project view, or right-click the project tree.

## Step 3: Create an inline agent

1. <!-- manual: Create or open an existing integration flow. -->
2. In the editor, open the **AI** section in the side panel and select **Agent**.
3. Select **+ Add Agent** to open the agent creation panel.
4. <!-- manual: Configure the Role and Instructions fields to define the agent’s behavior. -->
5. <!-- manual: Specify the query or prompt to the agent in the Query field. Note that this can also be an expression (e.g., a parameter, a variable, etc.). -->
6. Select **Save**.
